articles.summary: As advanced therapy programs move from clinical stages to commercialization, their operations become more complex and exposed to potential risks and friction in the supply chain. More products, materials, sites, and stakeholders must be coordinated, making continuity and visibility across the supply chain increasingly important. An integrated approach can help reduce handoff points, simply coordination, and mitigate risks that can lead to delays, errors, and added costs.
articles.title: Reduce Supply Chain Friction Through Greater Integration

articles.summary: When we opened our Global Supply Chain Center (GSCC) in Louvres, France, just minutes from Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport, we spoke about a vision that extended beyond logistics. As part of that vision, we shared plans to add our comprehensive BioServices in the months following the facility’s opening, including biostorage, custom kit production, packaging, labeling, and Qualified Person (QP) services. While our comprehensive logistics capabilities remain fully operational and available in Paris, we're excited to share that the next phase of our GSCC is nearing completion.
articles.title: Building End-to-End Support in Europe: Paris GSCC Nears Completion of Its Next Phase

articles.summary: As the cell and gene therapy industry grows, quality requirements are continuously evolving and posing new challenges. In response, Cryoport Systems developed a new shipping system to support the demands of advanced therapy supply chains. Expected to launch in 2027, the HV3 Advanced Therapy Shipper (ATS) will exclusively support clinical and commercial cell and gene therapy supply chains, with traceability, quality controls, and a scalable model for future expansion.
articles.title: Coming Soon to Cryoport Systems: Cryoport Express® Cryogenic HV3 Advanced Therapy Shipper®

articles.summary: New therapeutic developments and technologies are constantly on the horizon of the animal health industry. Many organizations working on regenerative medicines, reproductive technologies, biologics, vaccines, and advanced therapies face challenges when they begin to expand and commercialize. These programs heavily rely on supply chain partners to move their biologics through clinical stages and distribution, and that’s where many run into challenges. Transporting sensitive materials can lead to contamination, delays, or operational costs, if not properly handled.
articles.title: Risk Mitigation as Strategy: Why Prevention Pays in Animal Health Logistics

articles.summary: Cryoport Systems was honored with the BioServices Innovation of the Year Award for the 2026 BioTech Breakthrough Awards. Our organization was recognized for being the first supply chain solutions company to receive ISO 21973 certification for advanced therapy logistics, making a meaningful impact on patient access to life-changing treatments worldwide.
articles.title: Cryoport Systems Wins 2026 BioServices Innovation of the Year Award for Industry Milestone in Advanced Therapy Logistics

articles.summary: Advanced therapy organizations face a number of operational complexities as they expand. While these organizations devote considerable resources to address pain points in the supply chain, many of these absorbed costs were actually avoidable in the first place. Developing an integrated cryopreservation strategy can help organizations reduce scrap rates, deviations, repeat testing, shipping failures, and schedule churn, ultimately improving the company’s bottom line.
articles.title: Cost Avoidance and Risk Reduction Through Integrated Cryopreservation

articles.summary: Cryoport Systems was recently honored with the Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Excellence Award at the 2026 European Supply Chain Excellence Awards! The Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Excellence Award recognizes life sciences organizations whose work has contributed to improving patient outcomes through operational excellence. Cryoport Systems earned this award for being the first global supply chain provider to achieve ISO 21973 certification and its role in developing the international standard for the transportation of human cells intended for therapeutic use.
articles.title: Cryoport Systems Awarded With 2026 European Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Excellence Award for Elevating Global Advanced Therapy Logistics
